g.text: Monthly normalized price trends and changes in annual average prices during the 2023 revenue downturn

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #168c86

g.text: Conventional DRAM and NAND prices declined in 2023, while HBM prices increased as AI-oriented memory demand began to emerge.

text.style: font-size: 11.25px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52636d

g.text: Baselines: DRAM DDR4 8Gb $3.93/chip (2022-01); NAND 64Gb MLC $4.81/chip (2022-01); HBM3 $188.37/stack (2022-01). All series begin at 100.

text.style: font-size: 11.25px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52636d

g.text: Annual averages use 12 monthly observations per product in each year. Percentage change = (2023 average / 2022 average − 1) × 100.
